mechanics.title: Structure bounding boxes
mechanics.description: Sends structure bounding box data to MiniHUD when it asks, so the structure overlay works on multiplayer servers.

getting_started: Nothing to do on the client. Players use MiniHUD's structure overlay as usual.
editor_notes: Modrinth: no commands yet in 0.1.x; commands to toggle features are planned. Config for the structures feature not checked. Confirm structure boxes render on the pack server (MP-5).
name: Servux
summary: Server-side support mod that lets MiniHUD show structure bounding boxes on multiplayer servers.
